subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Channel Tunnel
description: A 60-second lesson on The Channel Tunnel.

hook.text: The Channel Tunnel runs 31 miles under the English Channel, connecting England and France by rail.

buildup.text: Eleven tunnel boring machines dug from both sides. They met in the middle with millimeter accuracy.

discovery.text: It's actually three tunnels: two for trains and one service tunnel for maintenance and emergencies.

twist.text: The project cost $21 billion—double the estimate. Every private investor lost money.

climax.text: Despite the financial pain, 400 million passengers have used it. It fundamentally linked two countries.

punchline.text: The tunnel lost money for investors but connected a continent.

quiz.question: How many parallel tunnels make up the Channel Tunnel?
